ns2:course.label: Seminar Lit Movements
ns2:course.description: Investigation of the development and mutation of literary movements (classicism, romanticism, symbolism, etc.) through a study of critical texts and their reception in various countries. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary.
